title: Humor: 'Irish Rover Version' lines about animals and the missing unicorns
summary: Second slide of the song-style Noah parody headed Genesis 6:19-22: a list of animals (green alligators, long-necked geese, humpty-backed camels, chimpanzees, cats, rats, elephants) ending with a joke about not forgetting unicorns, credited as 'IRV - Irish Rover Version'. Lines are summarised here rather than copied word for word.

text.text: [Lyric-style lines, summarised not copied: a list of animals for the ark (alligators, geese, camels, chimpanzees, cats, rats, elephants) and a closing joke about not forgetting the unicorns. 'Green' is in green, 'caMels' in gold, 'elephants' in grey.]

uncertain: Song-lyric lines on this slide were not transcribed verbatim (summarised in a note block) because song lyrics are not reproduced. The word 'camels' is styled 'caMels' with an enlarged M on the slide.
